subject: Re-sending with chapter attached
text: I realized after sending the last message that I left off the actual chapter file, so consider this the corrected version. It is still rough, especially after the second half, but I need your opinion on the pacing rather than whether every sentence sounds polished. The middle section is where I lost my way after the interview with the librarian, and now it reads to me as if the argument jumps from one example to another without letting either one land. If you notice any place where you felt bored, confused, or unsure why it matters, please mark it briefly in the margins or reply with a few line notes. I do not need a rewrite, only a reader's reaction. Also, if the ending feels like it is trying too hard to tie everything together, say so plainly. I am comfortable hearing that it is uneven. I want to decide whether the final pages should be shortened or expanded before I submit the next revision to the seminar. There is no rush beyond early next week, unless you already have a better time later in the week. If you have only ten minutes, a quick voice note about what confused you is just as useful. I would rather receive an honest impression than a careful edit. The missing attachment made the previous request feel half-finished, and I apologize for that. Whatever works for you is fine. Thanks,
